name: securejobva-repo-root
description: The one dev dependency for securejobva/tools/check-cleanup.mjs, which parses sql/cleanup-paying-half.sql with Postgres's own grammar. It lives here rather than in securejobva/ because this is the repo root and because Vercel's Root Directory is securejobva/ — a package.json in there would put an npm install into a build that vercel.json defines as `node build.mjs`, with no dependencies. Nothing in dist/ comes from this file.
